purpose: Debian status annotation for the 137 baseline entries from the Trivy DB (Debian Security Tracker data). Input is an SBOM built from the baseline's own package/version pairs and the DB is the same Trivy 0.76.2 / same-day DB as CI, so the match with the baseline is near-tautological and NOT independent evidence; the new information is the per-CVE Status. This is NOT a scan of the image; the image scans are CI runs 44761714650 / 44762695742.
command: docker run aquasec/trivy:0.76.2 sbom --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --format json docs/audit-2026-11-20/baseline-packages.cdx.json
